status: Proposed AA demo wiring; unpowered connectivity checked, physical assembly and powered tests required
power_topology: 4xAA NiMH to manual master switch to regulated 5V; servo rail always powered while master is on; Pico VSYS through D1

parts.BAT: Pololu 1153 holder with four matched AA NiMH cells; red positive, black negative
parts.F1: Inline fuse near battery positive; rating and holder selected in demo BOM
parts.RCY: Polarized two-pole disconnect with both mated contact pairs shown; verify actual wire polarity
parts.MASTER: Pololu 2810 LV; use onboard slide, leave ON disconnected
parts.REG: Pololu 2574 S18V20F5 fixed 5V; leave ENABLE disconnected
parts.PICO: Headered Pico W for breadboard; USB socket at top
parts.D1: 1N5819 Schottky from regulated 5V to VSYS; cathode stripe toward Pico
parts.C1: 470uF >=10V electrolytic across external 5V/GND; negative stripe to GND
parts.R_PWM1: Optional 1k ohm series servo 1 signal resistor
parts.SERVO0: MG90S servo; identify power, ground and signal from actual supplier pinout
parts.P5V: WAGO 221-415 five-port lever connector; all five ports are internally connected
parts.PGND_A: WAGO 221-415 five-port lever connector; all five ports are internally connected
parts.PGND_B: WAGO 221-415 five-port lever connector; all five ports are internally connected

rules: Servo power is continuously present while master is ON; no software power gate exists.
Servo motor supply and return use direct external wiring, not breadboard strips or Pico pins.
Pico branch uses regulated 5V through D1 into physical pin39 VSYS; never raw pack to VBUS.
Pico VBUS and 3V3_OUT remain unconnected on this breadboard.
RCY is shown connected for the continuity model; unplug it for servicing or changing wiring.
No battery ADC or automatic low-battery cutoff is included. Supervised demo only; regulator undervoltage lockout is not four-cell NiMH protection.
Unpowered wiring graph does not model diode, fuse, regulator, master switch, Pico internals or motor dynamics.
